summary: Preserved candidate PR 3181's piggyback reporting and corrected the three independently reviewed Rust /v1/loads counterexamples: the scheduler watch publication now seeds and refreshes the Rust newest-per-rank cache without requiring generation frames, Prometheus output is supported, and accelerator topology is carried through the typed launch handoff.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: a successful watch publication made zero calls into the Rust cache when no generation frame existed. Raw output: /job/reports/j-fcde7ccf0fa0/evidence/failing-before-watch.txt

tests.command: cargo test -p sglang-server loads_preserves_prometheus_and_metadata_contract (candidate-equivalent source plus regression)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: format=prometheus returned HTTP 400 instead of 200. Raw output: /job/reports/j-fcde7ccf0fa0/evidence/failing-before-endpoint.txt

Exact-candidate source check independently confirmed the explicit Prometheus rejection and both metadata fields hard-coded to null. Raw output: /job/reports/j-fcde7ccf0fa0/evidence/failing-before-source-contract.txt
14 focused Python tests passed, covering generation piggybacking, newest-timestamp arbitration, Python watch merging, and the new generation-independent Rust cache update.
All 266 Rust tests passed with pinned Rust 1.92, including direct Rust handler coverage for Prometheus samples and non-null accelerator metadata.

tests.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-fcde7ccf0fa0/cargo-target cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release -p sglang-server; direct importlib import
tests.what_was_measured: Rebuilt the optimized native extension, imported /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-fcde7ccf0fa0/cargo-target/release/libsglang_server.so directly, and confirmed Server.update_load_snapshot is exported.
Rust formatting and patch whitespace checks passed.

gpu_evidence: No GPU execution was needed: the defects are deterministic scheduler-to-Rust cache, HTTP formatting, and typed configuration handoff behavior. No numerical or model-architecture claim is made.
remaining_limitations: No live model server was launched because model weights are not required to validate these control-plane defects.
Multi-rank and multi-node serving were not exercised; newest-per-rank cache arbitration remains covered by unit tests.
The change does not claim semantic model accuracy, GPU numerical behavior, or coverage of a model architecture.
